votes.motion: Councilor Hoban nominated Councilor Katrice MacKay as chair. Vice-Chair Whipple called for a vote on the nomination.
Chair Garrett nominated the Councilor Craig Christensen as vice chair. Vice-Chair Whipple called for a vote on the nomination.
An implied motion to approve Resolution 2026-1, as currently constituted, has been                      made by council rule. Daniel Softley, Director of Human Resources, presented.

An implied motion to approve Ordinance 2026-1, as currently constituted, has been                      made by council rule. Dustin Wright, City Planner, presented the proposed rezone request for a property the applicant is seeking to rezone to the Medium Density Residential (MDR) zone.

An implied motion to approve Ordinance 2026-2, as currently constituted, has been                      made by council rule. Nancy Robison, City Planner, presented a proposed rezone for a 0.6-acre, irregularly shaped property located near 850 West and 1149 North.
An implied motion to approve Ordinance 2026-3, as currently constituted, has been                      made by council rule. Aaron Ardmore, Planning Supervisor, presented.

An implied motion to approve Resolution 2026-2, as currently constituted, has been                       made by council rule. Shane Jones, City Engineer, presented the City’s water conservation plan, noting that state law requires the plan to be reviewed and adopted by the Council every five years.
